mapper.insert: INSERT INTO background_job (id, enterprise_id, owner_user_id, kind, dedupe_key, payload_json, available_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{value}, #{enterprise}, #{user}, 'notification', #{value2}, #{value3}, #{availableAt}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = background_job.id
mapper.select: SELECT payload_json, created_at FROM background_job WHERE id = #{id} AND enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND owner_user_id = #{user} AND kind = 'notification' AND status = 'queued' FOR UPDATE
